C0308.title: Authorities Dismantle World's Largest IoT DDoS Botnet
C0308.summary: The U.S. Department of Justice announced the successful takedown of the world's largest IoT DDoS botnet. Court documents revealed that the Aisuru botnet issued over 200,000 DDoS attack commands, while the KimWolf botnet issued over 25,000, both used to launch record-breaking attacks.
